## Modules

- [Vix.Operator](https://vix.hexdocs.pm/Vix.Operator.md): 
Provides an intuitive and readable interface for performing image processing operations by overriding common mathematical and relational operators.
- [Vix.Tensor](https://vix.hexdocs.pm/Vix.Tensor.md): Struct to hold raw pixel data returned by the libvips along with metadata about the binary.
- [Vix.Vips](https://vix.hexdocs.pm/Vix.Vips.md): Module for Vix.Vips.

- [Vix.Vips.Image](https://vix.hexdocs.pm/Vix.Vips.Image.md): Primary module for reading and writing image and image metadata.
- [Vix.Vips.Interpolate](https://vix.hexdocs.pm/Vix.Vips.Interpolate.md): Make interpolators for operators like `affine` and `mapim`.

- [Vix.Vips.MutableImage](https://vix.hexdocs.pm/Vix.Vips.MutableImage.md): Vips Mutable Image
- [Vix.Vips.MutableOperation](https://vix.hexdocs.pm/Vix.Vips.MutableOperation.md): Module for Vix.Vips.MutableOperation.

- [Vix.Vips.Operation](https://vix.hexdocs.pm/Vix.Vips.Operation.md): Provides access to VIPS operations for image processing.

- Exceptions
  - [Vix.Vips.Image.Error](https://vix.hexdocs.pm/Vix.Vips.Image.Error.md)
